summary: Start a deployment at resource group. Please specify only one of --template-file FILE | --template-uri URI | --template-spec to input the ARM template.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: The resource group to create deployment at.

parameters.name: --aux-subs
parameters.help: Auxiliary subscriptions which will be used during deployment across tenants. WARNING: Option '--aux-subs' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use '--aux-tenants' instead.

parameters.name: --aux-tenants
parameters.help: Auxiliary tenants which will be used during deployment across tenants.

parameters.name: --confirm-with-what-if
parameters.help: Instruct the command to run deployment What-If before executing the deployment. It then prompts you to acknowledge resource changes before it continues.

parameters.name: --handle-extended-json-format
parameters.help: Support to handle extended template content including multiline and comments in deployment. WARNING: Option '--handle-extended-json-format/-j' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

parameters.name: --mode
parameters.help: The deployment mode.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The deployment name.

parameters.name: --no-prompt
parameters.help: The option to disable the prompt of missing parameters for ARM template. When the value is true, the prompt requiring users to provide missing parameter will be ignored. The default value is false.

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --parameters
parameters.help: Supply deployment parameter values. Parameters may be supplied from a file using the `@{path}` syntax, a JSON string, or as `<KEY=VALUE>` pairs. Parameters are evaluated in order, so when a value is assigned twice, the latter value will be used. It is recommended that you supply your parameters file first, and then override selectively using KEY=VALUE syntax. Also note if you are providing a bicepparam file then you can use this argument only once.

parameters.name: --proceed-if-no-change
parameters.help: Instruct the command to execute the deployment if the What-If result contains no resource changes. Applicable when --confirm-with-what-if is set.

parameters.name: --query-string
parameters.help: The query string (a SAS token) to be used with the template-uri in the case of linked templates.

parameters.name: --rollback-on-error
parameters.help: The name of a deployment to roll back to on error, or use as a flag to roll back to the last successful deployment.

parameters.name: --template-file
parameters.help: The path to the template file or Bicep file.

parameters.name: --template-spec
parameters.help: The template spec resource id.

parameters.name: --template-uri
parameters.help: The URI to the template file.

parameters.name: --validation-level
parameters.help: The deployment validation level. May be set to "Provider" (the default), "Template", or "ProviderNoRbac". With a validation level of "provider", ARM will perform full validation and check that you have sufficient permission to deploy all resources in the template. With a validation level of "providerNoRbac", ARM will perform full validation but only check for read permissions on each resource. With a validation level of "template", only static validation will be performed: preflight and permissions checks will be skipped.

parameters.name: --what-if
parameters.help: Instruct the command to run deployment What-If.

parameters.name: --what-if-exclude-change-types
parameters.help: Space-separated list of resource change types to be excluded from What-If results. Applicable when --confirm-with-what-if is set.

parameters.name: --what-if-result-format
parameters.help: The format of What-If results. Applicable when `--confirm-with-what-if` is set.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
